title: Update the taq102 package for the core/platform split before the next version bump
notes: On 2026-10-27 `src/` became `core/` and `platform/linux-fb/`, and the source list moved to `dmxdesk.sources` at the repository root with paths. spectalive/taq102's `br2-external/package/dmxdesk/dmxdesk.mk` still builds `$(@D)/src/` with `-I$(@D)/src`, which is right for the pinned release but fails on any tag after the split. Next: when bumping, change it to `-I$(@D)/core -I$(@D)/platform/linux-fb` and `$(addprefix $(@D)/,$(shell cat $(@D)/dmxdesk.sources))`. The Buildroot cross-compiler already links the split tree, and its stripped binary is byte-identical to the pre-split one.
result: No change is left for the bump beyond DMXDESK_VERSION and the hash.
evidence: spectalive/taq102 1d5b60c: dmxdesk.mk and tools/build-dmxdesk.sh accept both layouts; pinned v0.1.10 rebuilds byte-identical (d68f4720...), dmxdesk main ecdeb7a cross-builds under -Werror with Buildroot GCC 14.3.0
